They pretty much share everything about you with tons of companies. This includes your height, weight, eating habits, your location, your habits in general, medical information, contacts, and device information.

Fiber has been as important as protein in my health journey and I would love to be able to see that daily vs tracking it manually. Thank you!

reviews.title: Better apps out there
reviews.text:
At this price, I would argue there are much better apps out there. I have been using for about 4-6 weeks, and have noticed a number of times that the actual calories on a day are not equal to what is shown on the trends graphs. I have noticed the same thing for water intake.

Creating recipes is annoying at times, and if you accidentally add an ingredient during recipe creation, there is no way to remove it. I usually just change the amount to 1gram so it doesn’t really impact the overall calories too much. But it’s annoying.

The AI feature gets it wrong 60% of the time. I get it’s not a perfect feature, but I have seen this be more intuitive in other apps.

Would really consider other apps, and I will not be using this one once my subscription ends.

reviews.title: Shady and Misleading
reviews.text:
I signed up for this app because of good reviews. Wasn’t able to even try it before screens came up that made it seem like I needed to purchase it. Not a trial option that I could see. I went ahead and subscribed for the year when another screen pops up, still before I could even try the app. They want more money for the AI feature. Now I’m $80 in and haven’t even tried it. So since I bought it I tried it. Went to the AI  feature and found it couldn’t even see the macros or information I was entering into the app, making it pretty useless as a coach. I tried to get a refund for that and was denied without explanation. As a calorie counter it’s alright but not worth $80. And no trial option I could find before spending. 
Frustrating.

reviews.title: I HATE this app
reviews.text:
I really dislike this calorie counter app. It's not user friendly at all. navigating through the menus feels clunky and confusing. Adding meals is unnecessarily complicated and time-consuming, which defeats the whole purpose of quick tracking. The food database is often inaccurate or missing common items, making it frustrating to log meals properly.
There are much simpler and more reliable apps available that provide better tracking and insights. On top of that, I tried to get a refund because I haven't been using the app, but my request was repeatedly denied without a clear explanation.
Overall, the app feels overpriced for what it offers, and the poor customer service just adds to the disappointment. I definitely won't be using or recommending this app.
